canon_pins.megaworld_note: CivilizationRadiusKm 400 times PresentMetersPerKm 0.55 equals 220. Angle π places Frontier Present on negative X. Country capitals are a separate CountryCenter frame.
canon_pins.law_text: Drop the dome; wind will do the rest.
canon_pins.density_law: The road is the door. No dome. Horse is led until a ride clip exists.

canon_pins.humanoid_body: CX male or CX female. Concordia face. Wardrobe on CX_Head, CX_Chest, CX_Shoulder_L, CX_Shoulder_R, CX_Hip, CX_Grip_R, CX_Back. People in this slice are npc_role_frontier_guard, npc_role_frontier_bandit, and npc_role_road_bandit skinned frontier.
canon_pins.flower_law: Hub only. Canon.HubLawRadius is 42 m. The Hub-ring Frontier gate at 34 m lies inside that disk, so steel there is a flower. The country discs are outside that rule.
canon_pins.kit_culture_note: The frontier kit's culture field says grove. This slice does not relabel the kit. Road culture here is timber, salvage plate, canvas, open sky.

pinewood_crossing.rule: Every id in this slice has cap 0 inside 12 m. S01 keeps two hitch horses, the stag, the hare, and the salt wyrm on its own rules.

side_quests.title: Council — Walk the Salt Chord
side_quests.backstory_public: The Alliance disc and the Couriers disc overlap by 21.54 m, and Pinewood Crossing sits inside both. Caravans out of the council have been treating the Crossing as an Alliance township. A warden at the hitch wants the chord walked as a road that stops at someone else's city.

objectives.text: Take the walk from the guard at the council hitch.
Lead the salt wagon, or walk, from the hitch to the 12 m exclusion rim. Do not enter it.
Bring the unfilled canteen back. The city keeps its own lettering.

side_quests.fail: Entering the 12 m disk, filling item_canteen_salt on the Crossing, or riding the horse.
side_quests.budget: The giver is the one guard on floor_council_hitch.

side_quests.title: Drift — Sail, Not a Roof
side_quests.backstory_public: Someone tried to roof the open 18.71 m between the Freenodes and the Couriers with wagon canvas. The wind took the sheet. The keeper who tried it is not a named Freenode. The shoulder guard wants the wind wagon across the gap with the sail still cloth.

objectives.text: Accept on the north drift shoulder.
Push the wind wagon across floor_drift_gap. On foot, or standing in the bed. No horse hitched.
Stop on the far rim with the sail unstaked. If enc_canvas_dive is up, take the pass and still build no roof.

side_quests.fail: Staking the sail, hitching faun_wagon_horse to veh_frontier_windwagon, or playing a sit clip.
side_quests.faction_condition: The +1 lands only if the sail stayed cloth.
side_quests.budget: The giver is the north shoulder guard, one of five.

side_quests.title: Cut — Two Different Bills
side_quests.backstory_public: The road bandit's cut is a toll on whatever crosses the 28.62 m gap. The dome bandit beside them wants the sky closed and wears a stolen yoke to say so. They share a camp and do not share a motive. Hearing both, and paying neither, is the work.

objectives.text: Hail the one road bandit. Let them name the cut.
Hear the dome bandit. The yoke stays a necklace.
Leave both alive. Build no roof. Pay no ransom chit. Tell the road bandit the gap stays a road.

side_quests.fail: Killing either camp body, raising a canopy, or minting a ransom payment.
side_quests.faction_note: open_road and road are role strings. This +1 writes the Couriers' Guild book, once. No third book.
side_quests.budget: The giver is the single npc_role_road_bandit.
